findings.summary: The config --json interface cannot resolve a request-selected Lane profile against project defaults that the active profile already shadows: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/config/layered_config.ts:146-160 returns profiles and only the already-selected effective field values, not the shadowed project values; plugins/immune-brain/runtime/v4_runtime.ts:192-195 accepts no profile argument. For example active profile max_parallel=4, requested profile omits it, and project default=2: the output exposes 4 but not 2, preventing the required request > requested profile > project > default order.
